wall.heading: Sign in to read the team knowledge base

draft.body: Only signed-in staff can see this page. It is not published and not in search or the sitemap.

scheduled.title: Scheduled
scheduled.body: Publishes on {{date}}. Until then only signed-in staff can see it.

changes.title: Unpublished changes
changes.body: You are previewing a new draft. Visitors see the version published on {{date}}.

archived.title: Archived
archived.body: Visitors get “This article was archived”. You see it because you are signed in as staff.
